description: Leading research on shrinking ML models (quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation) so they run directly on resource-constrained IoT hardware like ESP32 microcontrollers, instead of needing a cloud round-trip.
Built and evaluated lightweight ML pipelines for TinyML-based security, aimed at energy-efficient threat detection directly on embedded devices.
Synthesized 60+ peer-reviewed papers on TinyML for cybersecurity to identify real gaps in the field.

Led migration for 25+ startup clients: scoped requirements, proposed the target architecture, then directed implementation combining Graviton compute, AWS Compute Optimizer right-sizing, autoscaling for variable traffic, and serverless refactors. Cut operational costs by ~25% on average, measured against AWS Cost Explorer.
Introduced Terraform to a client base that had been provisioning infrastructure by hand, building reusable modules, including a standardized Lambda + API Gateway pattern.
Integrated AI workflows (Lambda, RDS, S3) into client infrastructure for data preprocessing, model training, and inference, cutting processing time by 25%.
Replaced a manual SSH deploy process (someone logging in to stop and rebuild the app by hand) with a real CI/CD pipeline on Jenkins, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy.
Automated routine provisioning with Terraform and Lambda, cutting manual effort by an estimated 80%.
Cut AWS bills 25% through a Reserved/Spot Instance strategy, and another 40% by moving eligible workloads to serverless.
Built LLM agents to automate in-house operations, speeding up infrastructure development by 40%.
Managed network infrastructure, including switches, routers, and firewalls, resulting in a 25% increase in network reliability and speed.
Led incident response efforts for critical system failures, achieving a mean time to resolution (MTTR) of less than 1 hour.
Developed scripts using PowerShell and Bash to automate routine tasks, reducing manual workload by 60%.
Set up and maintained monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix) to track system health and performance, leading to a 50% reduction in downtime.
